book.arconia.guide_book.main.diary.name: Diary
book.arconia.guide_book.main.diary_chapt:
Dear diary. I have been traveling for several days now, and have lost my bearings.
It has been days since I departed the last village I visited, but luckily I am no stranger to
adventure, and I have stockpiled provisions so I will be fine for quite some time to come.

Dear diary. I have ventured into a rather dense forest. I am pretty sure that on the other side is the
civilization I seek. I'm going to set up camp high up in the trees to be safe from these pesky zombies
that always seem to find me.

For as dense as this forest is, it seems to be strangely devoid of your typical nasty creatures that lurk in
the shadows. I can only hope that this is a positive sign.

Dear diary. Last night I was disturbed in my sleep by some unfamiliar noises.
I swear it sounded like coins being tossed into piles.
But coins have no business of being in an otherwise deserted forest, so this must be my imagination
running wild. It has been a few days since I last had a proper dinner.

Dear diary. The noises came back last night, and this time I was able to discover a bit more.
Remember those stories from over-imaginative travellers at taverns around the world?
About the little green Leprechauns hoarding their riches, only to have their stashes disclosed
by giant multicolored arches in the sky?

Yeah, they might have been on to something, because what I just witnessed struck an uncanny resemblance
to those tales. I am safe for now, but I have to be careful not to make any noises.

Dear diary. It's been several days since my discovery, and from what I can tell,
 much of the stories about these so-called Leprechauns is true.
 My mind is slowly going from lack of food though,
 but I still have enough to survive for a few days more.

Meanwhile, I am writing down as many details as I can in the back of my notebook so that I
can replicate the tricks I've witnessed and finally be able to settle down!
At least they are not on to me yet, thanks to my ability to be practically invisible.
Who knew that skill would one day prove to be valuable?

Dear diary. I have discovered all that I can, and I really need to be able to find my way back
to the nearest village. Tomorrow, I will start my travels to replenish.
I have definitely felt better. My supplies have run out, and I must be careful making my escape
to not get caught.

I'm confident my notes are detailed enough so that I can reclaim all of the stuff the
Leprechauns have stolen. I can't trust any of the villagers with anything though,
so I will bury my notes here where they will be safe from prying eyes.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.infinite_ri:
I have written about my encounters with a group of Leprechauns in my diary.
In this section, I have carefully documented all of the rituals I witnessed them perform.
These rituals will allow me to collect a great amount of treasure,
once I have retraced my steps back into the civilized world.
This will end my days of wandering in rags for good. Maybe I'll even share some of it
with others ... in exchange for services and other niceties of course!
book.arconia.guide_book.main.name: Main
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_ar:
Now that I have my pot of gold setup and rituals ready to go, let's extract our first piece of treasure:
arconium essence!
I observed in detail one of the Leprechauns performing a ritual to imbue a red tree branch with this magical
essence. Once imbued, he used it on the pot of gold, which then displayed an apparition of the item above it.
Soon after, that very same item popped out of the pot as if created out of thin air! With a chest placed
nearby, the item was captured automatically.

I wrote down the exact ingredients needed to perform the ritual, and they can be found by looking up the
recipe for red arconium essence.
There are more items the red branch can be imbued with once we have our essence in hand. To find
out which, look up recipes using the red branch. I can even lookup any and all rituals by looking up
recipes using the center pedestal!
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_bl: I know the drill by now. Sickle, sapling, essence, new ingot!!
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_ce:
To complete the ritual setup, I also need a pedestal made from stone. Once crafted, I need to place it down
and surround it with up to eight wood pedestals nearby. A ritual requires items to be placed on the wood
pedestals, and is then started by using the clover staff on the stone pedestal. The ritual will
consume the placed down items, and magically transform them into a new item.

The generated item will appear on the center pedestal once the ritual is done.
There are many recipes. They can be found typically by looking them up from the center pedestal, or
from items used in the recipes, e.g. the colored tree branches.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_cl:
While observing the leprechauns, I noticed they were obsessed with four leaf clovers, and for good reason.
While punching clovers found in the wild with my fists, I would occasionally get one. Hitting them
with a staff crafted using a four leaf clover however is more rewarding. Even more so if the staff is further
blessed with good fortune.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_co:
The colorful branches can be used to turn regular grass into a colored version that matches
the color of the branch. A nifty little trick that we will need later!
Changing the color of grass this way will however consume the branch,
so let's gather a good amount of these.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_gr: I know the drill by now. Sickle, sapling, essence, new ingot!!
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_li: I know the drill by now. Sickle, sapling, essence, new ingot!!
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_or:
Like before, orange ingots are crafted from orange arconium essence. I'll have to imbue an orange branch
to extract orange essence from the pot. For the extraction to work, the pot will now also require an orange
tree planted in one of the 8 positions surrounding it. The colored grass around the tree needs to match the
color of the tree as well. If planted successfully, the pot will show orange rainbow particles.

I will use my new sickle to break the leaves of red arconium trees to get a small chance to have them
drop orange saplings. This, in turn, will give me orange branches, that can be imbued using the ritual to
get more advanced items than I could get with the red branches. Like before, the first thing I should focus
on is getting orange arconium essence first.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_pe:
All strange, magical things in life somehow seem to involve a ritual performed in a
circular fashion. One needs to utter some hard to pronounce wordsm and then smack things with a wand or staff.
The Leprechauns clearly were not going to stray from this seemingly imposed doctrine, and invented
a ritual of their own. Firstly, we're going to need several pedestals made from wood to make the circle.
Eight will do.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_po:
There's this well known myth that you can find a pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. Of course, once you
actually set out to find it, it turns out to be a mirage. But as I discovered, there is some truth to it, and
I know just how to turn it into reality.
Instead of finding such a pot, however, we need to construct one ourselves.

Luckily, studying the Leprechauns has revealed the secret to me. I have included instructions
on how to build it from a collection of blocks on the next page.
Once built, using the clover staff on it brings it to life. By itself, it doesn't do much yet,
but I'll detail the rest later. First, however, let's build it.

Great! Now that I have successfully built the pot, I'll setup the rest so I can get filthy rich.
As a first step, I need something to store all the loot I'll be ehm.. borrowing.
A chest will do, placed close to the pot.
Next, use an imbued tree branch (remember from my earlier instructions?) on the pot.
With that done, I should see an item appear over the pot. This is the item the pot will
extract from the treasure pool.

The pot will only extract treasure if certain trees are placed nearby at very specific locations.
The red trees I have obtained the branches from earlier will work for now.
I've included a drawing that shows all 8 possible locations in a 15 by 15 area around the pot where
the trees can be planted. Each location is a 3 by 3 area with red colored grass (see my previous notes)
on the outsides and regular grass or dirt in the center. The base of the pot itself needs to be on the
same Y level as the base of the trees, or one block higher or lower.

I only need to plant a single tree to get started, but I could plant more if I want to. Once a fully
grown tree is in the right place, the pot of gold will be activated and start consuming its leaves.
If that does not happen, look at the pot. It will indicate if something's missing before it will work.
A chest icon indicates it couldn't find a place nearby to store the loot. A leaf block indicates it could
not find a tree at any of the expected locations (remember to surround it with the red grass!). And of
course it needs to be activated with one of the imbued branches to produce anything.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_pu: I know the drill by now. Sickle, sapling, essence, new ingot!!
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_re:
One of the first things I'll want to make using the red arconium essence is a magical red metal, which will
prove very useful to unlock more treasure to steal, I mean, borrow. I can once
again use the ritual to craft it, assuming the particular universe I'm in today didn't sneakily alter it.
Either way, looking up the recipe for red arconium ingots should provide me with the exact ingredients and
method needed.

Normally, when one chops a red arconium tree, it will drop saplings to grow another red tree.
However, I learned from the Leprechauns that you can get them to drop saplings for a different color using
the magic powers of a hand-crafted sickle.
It must be made from arconium ingots to give it this special ability. The colors are not random; there is a
clear progression in colors, lining up with the colors in a rainbow.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_st:
The clover staff will prove very useful for our plans. For once, using it to break clovers found in the world
increases the odds of getting four-leaf clovers. That should save me some time exploring!
Enchanting it with fortune will increase the odds even more, so I should make sure to do this first change I
get.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_tr:
I'm going to have to look for red trees with bright sparkling leaves growing in forested areas.
When chopping down these trees, the occasional branch falls out. I'll need a lot of these to perform
the next steps towards a life of peaceful luxury.
book.arconia.guide_book.main.progress_ye: I know the drill by now. Sickle, sapling, essence, new ingot!!
